description: This is a unit test source file for the ImmutableJsonWebToken class, testing its immutability, equality, exception handling, parsing, and expiration logic.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonWebTokenTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying behaviors of ImmutableJsonWebToken.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ImmutableJsonWebToken is properly immutable and its collection fields are safely copied with immutable elements.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the implementation of hashCode() and equals() methods using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceFromEmptyTokenString
methods.description: Tests that an IllegalArgumentException is thrown when attempting to create a token from an empty string.

methods.name: tryToParseTokenFromMissingAuthorization
methods.description: Tests that a JwtInvalidException is thrown when parsing a token without proper authorization string.

methods.name: tryToParseTokenFromInvalidAuthorization
methods.description: Tests that a JwtInvalidException is thrown when authorization string is improperly formatted.

methods.name: tryToParseTokenWithMissingSignature
methods.description: Tests that an exception is thrown when token signature is missing during parsing.

methods.name: parseToken
methods.description: Parses a well-formed token and verifies the header, payload, and signature are correctly extracted.

methods.name: checkTokenExpiration
methods.description: Checks if the token correctly reports expiration based on the 'exp' claim.

methods.name: base64
methods.description: Helper method to Base64-encode a string.
